recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, pecorino, and parmesan cheese.
Cook the pancetta in a large pan until crispy.
Drain the spaghetti and reserve some pasta water.
Toss the spaghetti with the pancetta, then remove from heat and mix in the egg mixture.
Add reserved pasta water to adjust the sauce consistency.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Pizza
ingredients: 1 packet (2 ¼ tsp) active dry yeast
1 cup canned tomato sauce or crushed tomatoes
1 teaspoon dried oregano or fresh basil
1 ½ cups shredded mozzarella cheese (or fresh mozzarella slices)
instructions: In a small bowl, mix warm water, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until foamy.
In a large bowl, mix flour and salt. Add yeast mixture and olive oil.
Knead for about 8-10 minutes until smooth.
Cover and let it rise for 1-1.5 hours or until doubled in size.
Mix the crushed tomatoes, oregano, salt, and garlic powder in a bowl.
Stir well and set aside.
Preheat oven to 475°F (245°C).
Roll out the dough into a round shape on a floured surface.
Transfer to a pizza stone or baking sheet.
Spread the sauce evenly over the dough.
Sprinkle mozzarella cheese and add fresh basil leaves.
Place in the oven and bake for 12-15 minutes or until the crust is golden and the cheese is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and drizzle with olive oil.
Let it cool for 2 minutes before slicing.

recipes.name: French fries
ingredients: ½ teaspoon pepper or seasoning of choice (optional)
instructions: Peel (optional) and cut potatoes into thin strips.
Soak the cut fries in cold water for at least 30 minutes (removes excess starch for crispiness).
Drain and pat dry with a paper towel.
Heat the Oil (5 minutes)
Heat oil in a deep fryer or pan to 325°F (163°C).
Ensure the oil is hot but not smoking.
Fry the potatoes in small batches for 4-5 minutes until soft but not browned.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Increase the oil temperature to 375°F (190°C).
Fry the potatoes again for 3-4 minutes until golden and crispy.
Remove and drain on paper towels.
Sprinkle salt and seasoning while hot.
Serve immediately with ketchup or dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Pasta
ingredients: 1 cup tomato sauce or chopped tomatoes
½ tsp oregano or basil (dried or fresh)
½ cup grated cheese (Parmesan or any preferred cheese)
instructions: Boil the Pasta:
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add a pinch of salt, and cook pasta as per package instructions (usually 8-12 minutes).
Drain and set aside.
Prepare the Sauce:
Heat olive oil in a pan, add garlic and onion, and sauté until soft.
Add tomato sauce, salt, pepper, chili flakes, and oregano/basil.
Let it simmer for 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Combine Pasta & Sauce:
Add the boiled pasta to the sauce and mix well.
Cook for 2 more minutes to coat the pasta evenly.
Serve:
Garnish with grated cheese and fresh parsley.
Serve hot and enjoy!

recipes.name: Burger
instructions: Prepare the Patty:
In a bowl, mix ground meat, onion, garlic, salt, pepper, paprika, and breadcrumbs.
Shape the mixture into 2 equal-sized patties.
Cook the Patty:
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Cook each patty for about 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked.
Place a cheese slice on each patty in the last minute of cooking.
Toast the Buns:
Cut the burger buns in half and lightly toast them on a pan or grill for 1-2 minutes.
Assemble the Burger:
Spread mayonnaise and ketchup/mustard on the bun.
Add lettuce, tomato slices, and the cooked patty.
Cover with the top bun and press lightly.
Serve & Enjoy:
Serve hot with fries or a side salad.

recipes.name: Fried chicken
ingredients: 1 kg (2.2 lbs) chicken (drumsticks, thighs, wings, or breasts)
Cooking oil (vegetable oil, canola oil, or peanut oil)
instructions: Marinate the Chicken:
Place chicken pieces in a bowl and pour buttermilk over them.
Cover and let them marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour (or overnight for better flavor).
Prepare the Coating:
In a large bowl, mix flour, salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne pepper, and baking powder.
Coat the Chicken:
Remove chicken from buttermilk, allowing excess to drip off.
Dip each piece in the beaten eggs, then coat it in the flour mixture.
For extra crispiness, repeat the coating process (dip in egg again and coat with flour).
Heat the Oil:
Heat oil in a deep pan or fryer to 170-180°C (340-360°F).
Make sure the oil is hot before frying to get crispy chicken.
Fry the Chicken:
Carefully place chicken in the hot oil and fry in batches.
Cook for about 12-15 minutes, flipping occasionally, until golden brown and crispy.
Internal temperature should reach 75°C (165°F).
Drain and Serve:
Remove the fried chicken and place it on a paper towel or wire rack to drain excess oil.
Serve hot with your favorite dips or side dishes.

recipes.name: Sizzling brownie
ingredients: ¼ cup chocolate sauce (store-bought or homemade)
1 tsp butter (for greasing the sizzler plate)
instructions: Make the Brownie
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Grease a baking dish with butter and dust with flour.
In a bowl, sift flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
In another bowl, mix melted butter and sugar until smooth. Add vanilla extract and milk.
Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet mixture and fold gently.
Pour the batter into the greased dish and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Once done, let the brownie cool and cut into squares.
Step 2: Prepare the Sizzler Plate
Heat the sizzler plate on a stovetop for 5 minutes.
Once hot, carefully place a piece of brownie on it.
Add a scoop of vanilla ice cream on top.
Step 3: Pour Chocolate Sauce and Serve
Drizzle warm chocolate sauce over the brownie and ice cream.
Enjoy the sizzling sound and serve immediately!

recipes.name: Gulab jamun
instructions: Prepare the Sugar Syrup:
In a pan, mix sugar and water.
Heat on medium flame until sugar dissolve completely.
Add cardamom, saffron, and rose water. Let it simmer for 5 minutes, then turn off the flame.
Make the Dough:
In a bowl, mix milk powder, all-purpose flour, and baking soda.
Add ghee and mix until it becomes crumbly.
Gradually add warm milk and knead into a soft, smooth dough. Let it rest for 5-10 minutes.
Shape and Fry the Jamuns:
Grease your hands and roll small, crack-free balls from the dough.Add lettuce, tomato slices, and the cooked patty.
Heat oil/ghee in a pan on low flame Add lettuce, tomato slices, and the cooked patty.
Fry the balls in small batches until they turn golden brown. Stir gently for even frying.
Soak in Sugar Syrup:
Remove the fried gulab jamuns and place them in warm sugar syrup.
Let them soak for at least 2 hours for the best taste.

recipes.name: chicken rolls
recipes.cuisine: Fusion (Can be adapted to Indian, American, or Asian flavors)
ingredients: 1 tsp soy sauce (optional, for Asian flavor)
1/2 tsp garam masala (optional, for Indian flavor)
instructions: Prepare the Filling:
Heat oil in a pan and sauté chopped onions and garlic until translucent.
Add shredded chicken and cook until tender.
Mix in capsicum, cabbage, soy sauce, black pepper, chili flakes, and salt. Cook for 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let it cool slightly.
Assemble the Rolls:
Take a tortilla/chapati or roll wrapper and place some filling in the center.
Drizzle some mayonnaise and ketchup over it.
Fold the sides and roll tightly. Seal the edges with beaten egg or a flour-water paste if needed.
Cooking Options:
Pan-Fry: Heat a little oil in a pan and cook the rolls until golden brown on all sides.
Bake: Preheat oven to 180°C (350°F) and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Air Fry: Cook at 180°C (350°F) for 8-10 minutes.

recipes.name: Chocolate Macarons
instructions: Prepare the Dry Ingredients
Sift almond flour, powdered sugar, and cocoa powder together.
Make the Meringue
Heat granulated sugar and water in a saucepan until it reaches 118°C (soft-ball stage).
Whip egg whites to soft peaks, then slowly pour in the sugar syrup while whipping until stiff peaks form.
Macaronage (Mixing the Batter)
Grease your hands and roll small, crack-free balls from the dough.Add lettuce, tomato slices, and the cooked patty.
Piping & Resting
Pipe small rounds onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Let them rest for 30-45 minutes until a skin forms on top.
Baking
Bake at 150°C (300°F) for 12-15 minutes.
Let them cool completely before removing from the tray.
Prepare the Ganache Filling
Heat heavy cream until just simmering, then pour over chopped chocolate.
Stir until smooth, adding butter for extra shine.
Assemble the Macarons
Pipe ganache onto one shell and sandwich with another.
Refrigerate for 24 hours for best flavor and texture.

recipes.name: Black Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 500g (1 lb) boneless chicken breast or thighs, cut into bite-sized pieces
1 tsp dark soy sauce (for color, optional)
1 tsp vinegar (rice vinegar or white vinegar)
½ cup bell peppers (red, green, or yellow), sliced
instructions: Marinate the Chicken
In a bowl, mix chicken pieces with soy sauce, oyster sauce, dark soy sauce, cornstarch, and sugar.
Let it marinate for 15 minutes.
Heat the Pan
Heat oil in a pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Cook the Chicken
Add marinated chicken and stir-fry for 5-7 minutes until golden brown.
Remove and set aside.
Sauté Vegetables
In the same pan, add a little more oil if needed.
Sauté garlic, ginger, onions, and bell peppers for 2 minutes.
Add Black Pepper & Chicken
Return the cooked chicken to the pan.
Add black pepper, white pepper, and vinegar.
Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, adding 2 tbsp water for a slight sauce.
Garnish & Serve
Garnish with spring onions and serve hot with rice or noodles.

recipes.name: Butterscotch Cake
instructions: Preheat Oven: Set your oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a cake pan.
Mix Dry Ingredients: In a bowl, sift flour, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Cream Butter & Sugar: In another bowl, beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy.
Add Eggs & Vanilla: Mix in eggs one at a time, followed by vanilla extract.
Combine Mixtures: Gradually add dry ingredients and milk, mixing until smooth.
Bake: Pour batter into the cake pan and bake for 35-40 minutes. Let it cool.
Make Butterscotch Sauce: In a pan, melt butter and brown sugar, then add cream and vanilla. Stir until thick.
Assemble: Drizzle the sauce over the cake or mix it into whipped cream for frosting.
Serve & Enjoy!

recipes.name: Butterscotch Ice Cream
instructions: Prepare the Butterscotch Sauce
In a saucepan, melt butter over medium heat.
Add brown sugar and stir continuously until it dissolves and forms a caramel-like texture (2-3 minutes).
Add a pinch of salt and mix well.
Make the Ice Cream Base
Pour milk and heavy cream into the saucepan with the butterscotch mixture. Stir well.

If using egg yolks: In a separate bowl, whisk egg yolks and slowly add a little warm mixture to temper them. Then pour back into the saucepan, stirring continuously until slightly thickened (do not boil).
Cool the Mixture
Remove from heat, stir in vanilla extract, and let the mixture cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or until completely chilled.
Churn & Freeze
Pour the chilled mixture into an ice cream maker and churn according to manufacturer instructions.
If you don’t have an ice cream maker, pour the mixture into a container, freeze for 1 hour, then stir. Repeat every 30 minutes for about 3-4 hours.
Final Touch
Fold in butterscotch chips if using.
Freeze for at least 6 hours or overnight before serving

recipes.name: chicken lolipops
ingredients: 10 chicken drumettes or wings (cleaned and shaped into lollipops)
instructions: Prepare the Chicken:
Take chicken wings or drumettes and shape them into lollipops by pushing the meat down to one end.
Marinate:
In a bowl, mix ginger-garlic paste, soy sauce, red chili powder, black pepper, and salt.
Add the chicken lollipops and coat well. Let them marinate for 15-20 minutes.
Prepare the Batter:
Mix all-purpose flour, cornflour, and egg (if using) in a bowl.
Add a little water to make a smooth batter.
Coat the Chicken:
Dip each marinated lollipop into the batter, ensuring an even coat.
Fry Until Golden Brown:
Heat oil in a deep pan and fry the lollipops on medium flame until crispy and golden brown.
Drain excess oil using a paper towel.
Serve:
Garnish with chopped spring onions and serve hot with schezwan sauce or chili garlic dip.

recipes.name: carrot chips
ingredients: ½ tsp paprika (optional, for extra flavor)
instructions: Preheat the Oven/Air Fryer:
Set the oven to 375°F (190°C) or preheat the air fryer to 350°F (175°C).
Slice the Carrots:
Use a mandoline slicer or knife to cut thin, even carrot slices.
Season the Carrots:
In a bowl, mix carrot slices with olive oil, salt, pepper, and optional seasonings.
Arrange and Bake/Air Fry:
Lay the slices in a single layer on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until crispy.
If using an air fryer, cook for 10-12 minutes, shaking the basket halfway.
Cool and Serve:
Let them cool for a few minutes to crisp up further.
Enjoy as a healthy snack!

recipes.name: carrot halwa
ingredients: ½ cup sugar (adjust as per taste)
instructions: Heat Ghee:
In a heavy-bottomed pan, heat 2 tbsp ghee and sauté the cashews, almonds, and raisins until golden. Remove and set aside.
Cook the Carrots:
In the same pan, add grated carrots and sauté for 5-7 minutes until they soften slightly.
Add Milk and Simmer:
Pour in the milk and cook on medium flame, stirring occasionally, until the milk reduces and thickens.
Sweeten the Halwa:
Add sugar and mix well. Continue cooking until the mixture thickens further and the halwa leaves the sides of the pan.
Enhance the Flavor:
Add cardamom powder and the remaining 2 tbsp ghee. Stir well.
Garnish & Serve:
Mix in the roasted nuts and raisins. Serve warm.

recipes.name: chips
ingredients: ½ tsp black pepper or paprika (optional)
instructions: Slice the Potatoes:
Wash and peel the potatoes.
Use a sharp knife or mandoline slicer to cut them into thin slices.
Soak in Water:
Place the potato slices in cold water for 10 minutes to remove excess starch.
Drain and pat dry using a paper towel.
Heat the Oil:
In a deep pan, heat oil over medium-high flame.
Fry Until Crispy:
Add potato slices in small batches and fry until golden brown and crispy.
Drain excess oil using a paper towel.
Season and Serve:
Sprinkle salt and pepper (or your favorite seasoning) while still warm.
Serve immediately for the best crunch!

recipes.name: choclate cake.jpg
ingredients: ½ cup vegetable oil or melted butter
2 eggs (or ½ cup yogurt for eggless)
½ cup hot water or coffee (for richness)
instructions: Preheat Oven & Prepare Pan:
Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F).
Grease a cake pan and line it with parchment paper.
Mix Dry Ingredients:
In a bowl, sift flour, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Mix Wet Ingredients:
In another bowl, whisk sugar, oil/butter, eggs (or yogurt), milk, and vanilla extract until smooth.
Combine & Add Hot Water:
Gradually add dry ingredients to the wet mixture.
Stir in hot water or coffee to create a smooth batter.
Bake:
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 25-30 minutes.
Check with a toothpick—if it comes out clean, the cake is done.
Cool & Serve:
Let the cake cool before slicing.
Serve as is or with chocolate frosting for extra richness.

recipes.name: choclates
ingredients: ¼ cup coconut oil or cocoa butter
2-3 tbsp honey or powdered sugar (adjust to taste)
instructions: Melt the Base:
In a double boiler or microwave, melt the coconut oil or cocoa butter until fully liquid.
Mix the Ingredients:
Add cocoa powder, honey (or sugar), vanilla extract, and salt.
Stir well until the mixture is smooth and lump-free.
Mold the Chocolate:
Pour the mixture into silicone molds or a lined tray.
Chill & Set:
Refrigerate for about 1 hour or until the chocolate is firm.
Enjoy!
Once set, break into pieces and enjoy homemade chocolate!

recipes.name: coffee
ingredients: 1 cup water (or milk for milk-based coffee)
1 tsp instant coffee powder or 2 tsp ground coffee
instructions: Boil Water/Milk:
Heat 1 cup of water in a pot until it reaches a gentle boil.
If using milk, heat it without boiling too much.
Add Coffee:
For instant coffee: Add 1 tsp instant coffee to a cup and pour hot water/milk over it. Stir well.
For ground coffee: Use a coffee filter, French press, or espresso machine to brew the coffee.
Sweeten (Optional):
Add sugar, honey, or sweetener as desired.
Enhance (Optional):
Add milk, cream, cinnamon, vanilla, or chocolate syrup for extra flavor
Serve:
Pour into a cup and enjoy hot. For iced coffee, chill and serve over ice.

recipes.name: cooldrinks
instructions: In a glass, mix lemon juice, sugar, and salt.
Add chilled water and mix well.
Add ice cubes and garnish with mint leaves.
Serve immediately and enjoy!

recipes.name: donuts
ingredients: Powdered sugar or chocolate glaze (for topping)
instructions: Activate the Yeast:
In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast. Let it sit for 5-10 minutes until frothy.
Prepare the Dough:
In a mixing bowl, combine flour, salt, butter, and egg (if using).
Add the activated yeast mixture and knead into a soft dough.
Let the Dough Rise:
Cover the dough and let it rise for 1 hour until it doubles in size.
Shape the Donuts:
Roll out the dough to about ½-inch thickness and cut out donut shapes using a cutter or glass.
Fry Until Golden Brown:
Heat oil in a pan and fry the donuts on medium heat until golden brown.
Drain excess oil on a paper towel.
Add Toppings:
Dust with powdered sugar or dip in chocolate glaze as per preference.

recipes.name: fried chicken
ingredients: 1 cup buttermilk (or ½ cup yogurt + ½ cup water)
instructions: Marinate the Chicken:
In a bowl, mix buttermilk, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add chicken pieces, coat well, and let it marinate for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best flavor).
Prepare the Coating:
In a separate bowl, mix flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and black pepper.
Coat the Chicken:
Remove chicken from buttermilk and let excess liquid drip off.
Dip in flour mixture, coat well, then dip in beaten egg (optional) and again in flour for a thicker crust.
Fry Until Golden & Crispy:
Heat oil in a deep pan to 350°F (175°C).
Fry chicken in batches for about 8-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden brown and fully cooked inside.
Drain on paper towels.
Serve:
Let the fried chicken rest for 5 minutes, then serve hot with ketchup, mayo, or  spicy dip.

recipes.name: ghee mysoorpak
ingredients: ½ cup oil (optional, for extra softness)
instructions: Roast the Besan:
Heat a pan and dry roast the besan on low flame until aromatic.
Ensure it does not turn brown.
Prepare Sugar Syrup:
In another pan, dissolve sugar in water and boil until it reaches a one-string consistency.
Add Roasted Besan:
Slowly add the roasted besan to the sugar syrup while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Incorporate Ghee:
Gradually pour in melted ghee while stirring.
Keep stirring until the mixture thickens and starts leaving the sides of the pan.
Set and Cut:
Pour the mixture into a greased tray.
Let it cool slightly and cut into square or diamond shapes.
Serve:
Enjoy your soft, melt-in-the-mouth Ghee Mysore Pak!

recipes.name: Halwa
ingredients: 1 cup semolina (suji) or wheat flour (for atta halwa) or grated carrot (for gajar halwa)
2 cups milk or water (based on type of halwa)
instructions: Heat Ghee:
In a pan, heat ghee on low flame.
Roast Semolina or Flour:
Add semolina (or flour) and roast until golden brown and fragrant.
For gajar halwa, sauté grated carrots in ghee until soft.
Prepare Sugar Syrup (if needed):
In another pan, heat water/milk and add sugar. Stir until dissolved.
Mix and Cook:
Slowly pour hot milk/water into the roasted mixture while stirring continuously to avoid lumps.
Flavor and Garnish:
Add cardamom powder, mix well, and cook until the halwa thickens.
Garnish with nuts and raisins.
Serve:
Enjoy warm, garnished with extra nuts.

recipes.name: laddu
instructions: Roast the Besan:
Heat ghee in a pan on low flame.
Add besan and roast it, stirring continuously until golden brown and aromatic (10-12 minutes).
Add Cardamom & Nuts:
Mix in cardamom powder and chopped nuts.
Cool & Add Sugar:
Let the mixture cool slightly. Then, add powdered sugar and mix well.
Shape the Laddus:
Take small portions and roll them into round balls.
Let Them Set:
Allow the laddus to cool and set properly before serving.

recipes.name: grillchicken
ingredients: Chicken (breasts, thighs, or drumsticks) – about 4 piece
Fresh herbs (like parsley or cilantro) – for garnish
instructions: Pat the chicken dry with a paper towel
If the chicken breasts are thick, you can pound them to an even thickness to ensure they cook evenly.
In a small bowl, mix the olive oil, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and paprika.
Brush or rub the mixture evenly over both sides of the chicken breasts.
Preheat your grill to medium-high heat (around 400°F or 200°C).
Lightly oil the grill grates to prevent the chicken from sticking.
Place the chicken on the preheated grill.
Grill for 5-7 minutes per side, depending on thickness.
Flip the chicken only once to get nice grill marks.
The chicken is done when its internal temperature reaches 165°F (75°C).
Remove the chicken from the grill and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
This helps keep the juices in Serve with your favorite side dishes,
like salad, rice, or grilled vegetables.

recipes.name: Butter chicken
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt
garam masala, cumin, and turmeric for 30 minutes
In a pan, melt butter and sauté onions
garlic, and ginger until soft
Add the marinated chicken and cook until browned
Stir in tomato puree and cook for 10 minutes
Add heavy cream and simmer for another 5 minutes
Garnish with cilantro and serve with rice or naan bread

recipes.name: Tacos al Pastor
instructions: Soak the dried chilies in hot water for 15 minutes
then blend with garlic, vinegar, cumin, and oregano to create a marinade.
Marinate the pork in the chili mixture for 1-2 hours
Grill the pork and pineapple slices until caramelized
Assemble tacos with grilled pork, pineapple, onion, cilantro, and a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Greek Salad with Grilled Shrimp
instructions: Toss the shrimp with olive oil, salt, and pepper
and grill for 2-3 minutes on each side
In a large bowl, combine cucumber, tomatoes, red onion, olives, and feta.
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar
then toss to coat
Top with grilled shrimp and serve

recipes.name: Shakshuka
instructions: Sauté onion
garlic, and bell pepper until soft
Stir in cumin, paprika, and diced tomatoes
then simmer for 10 minutes
Make small wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them
Cover and cook until the eggs are set (about 5 minutes)
Garnish with parsley and serve with crusty bread

recipes.name: Beef Stir-Fry
instructions: Marinate the Beef:In a bowl,toss the thinly sliced beef with 1 tablespoon of soy sauce
1 tablespoon cornstarch
and a pinch of salt and pepper
Let it marinate for 15–20 minutes
Prepare the Stir-Fry Sauce:In a small bowl, mix the remaining 1 tablespoon of soy sauce
oyster sauce, hoisin sauce (if using), and beef broth or water. Set aside
Stir-Fry the Beef:Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a wok or large skillet over high heat
Add the marinated beef in a single layer and stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until it browns and is mostly cooked through
Remove from the pan and set aside
Stir-Fry the Vegetables:In the same pan, add another tablespoon of oil if needed.Add minced garlic, ginger, onions, and bell peppers
Stir-fry for 3–4 minutes until the vegetables soften but are still slightly crunchy
Combine the Beef and Sauce:Return the beef to the pan with the vegetables
Pour the stir-fry sauce over the mixture and toss everything together
Stir-fry for another 1–2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the beef and vegetables
Finish with Sesame Oil: Drizzle sesame oil over the stir-fry for extra flavor
Serve hot over cooked rice.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
ingredients: 4 medium tomatoes (diced, or 1 can diced tomatoes)
1 teaspoon dried thyme (or fresh thyme sprigs)
instructions: Prep the Eggplant: Cut eggplant into cubes
sprinkle with salt,and let it sit for 20 minutes
Rinse and pat dry
Cook the Vegetables: Heat olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Cook the eggplant until soft
then remove it
the Rest: In the same pan, sauté onion, garlic, and bell pepper for 5 minutes
Add zucchini and yellow squash, cooking for another 5 minutes
Add Tomatoes and Seasoning: Stir in tomatoes, cooked eggplant, thyme, oregano, salt, and pepper
Simmer for 20 minutes, covered
Serve: Remove from heat, garnish with fresh basil, and serve hot.

recipes.name: Chocolate Lava Cake
instructions: Grease the Ramekins:Butter 4 small ramekins or muffin tins. Preheat your oven to 425°F (220°C)
Melt Butter and Chocolate:Microwave the butter and chocolate chips together in a bowl for 1 minute. Stir until smooth
Mix Sugar and Eggs:Stir powdered sugar into the melted chocolate. Then add eggs and yolks, and mix until smooth
Add Flour:Stir in flour and a pinch of salt until just combined
Bake:Pour the mixture into the greased ramekins and bake for 12–14 minutes
The edges should be set, but the center will still be soft
Serve:Let cool for 1 minute, then carefully flip onto a plate. Serve with ice cream if you like

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
instructions: Cook Rice:Boil 4 cups of water in a pot. Add rice and cook for 10 minutes until 70% done. Drain and set aside
Cook Chicken:Heat oil in a pan, fry onions until golden
Add ginger-garlic paste, tomatoes, biryani masala, and chicken. Cook for 10 minutes
Stir in yogurt and cook for another 5 minutes.
Layer:In a large pot, layer chicken at the bottom, then the half-cooked rice on top
Steam:Cover and cook on low heat for 10 minutes to let the flavors mix

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
instructions: Heat butter in a pan, sauté chopped onions until soft. Add ginger-garlic paste and cook for 2 minutes
Add tomato puree, chili powder, turmeric, and salt. Cook until the sauce thickens (about 5 minutes).
Add paneer cubes and cook for 2-3 minutes, gently stirring to coat.
Stir in cream and garam masala. Simmer for 2 minutes.
Serve hot with naan or rice

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add mustard seeds and let them splutter
Add sliced onions, green chili, curry leaves, and turmeric. Sauté until onions are soft.
Add mashed potatoes and salt. Mix and cook for 2–3 minutes. Set aside.
Heat a non-stick pan or tawa. Pour a ladle of store-bought dosa batter onto the center and spread it in a circle.
Drizzle a little oil around the edges and cook until crispy and golden brown.
Place a spoonful of the potato masala in the center of the dosa.
Fold the dosa and serve with chutney or sambar.

recipes.name: Rogan Josh
ingredients: 500g lamb or goat meat (cut into pieces)
1 tablespoon red chili powder (adjust to taste)
instructions: Heat oil or ghee in a large pot. Add finely chopped onions and sauté until golden brown
Add ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, turmeric, cumin, coriander, and fennel seeds (if using). Stir for 1 minute
Add the meat pieces and sear on high heat until browned
Add the tomato puree and yogurt, stirring well. Cook for 5 minutes until the oil starts to separate from the sauce
Add 2 cups of water and salt. Cover and simmer on low heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour until the meat is tender and the gravy thickens
Stir in garam masala and cook for another 5 minutes. Garnish with fresh coriander

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
ingredients: Ready-made bhature dough (available in stores) or store-bought frozen bhature
instructions: Heat oil in a pan. Add chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste. Cook until onions are soft
Add chopped tomatoes, turmeric, salt, and chole masala. Stir and cook for 5 minutes until tomatoes soften
Add chickpeas and a little water. Simmer for 10 minutes
Heat oil in a pan
Fry ready-made bhature until they puff up and turn golden brown

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
instructions: Mix crumbled paneer, mashed potato, cornflour, and salt in a bowl. Form small balls (koftas)
Heat oil in a pan and deep-fry the koftas until golden brown. Remove and set aside
Heat oil in a pan. Add chopped onions and ginger-garlic paste. Sauté until onions turn golden
Add tomato puree, turmeric, chili powder, and salt. Cook for 5 minutes until the oil separates from the gravy
Stir in cream (or milk) and garam masala. Simmer for 2-3 minutes to make a creamy gravy
Add the fried koftas to the gravy just before serving and garnish with fresh coriander

recipes.name: Pani Puri
instructions: In a bowl, mix tamarind paste, chaat masala, cumin powder, salt, and 3 cups of cold water. Stir well.
Mash the boiled potatoes and add a pinch of salt.
Crack a hole in the puri, fill with a spoonful of potato filling, and pour in the prepared pani.

recipes.name: Chicken Fry
ingredients: Chicken - 500 grams (boneless or bone-in, cut into small pieces)
Red chili powder - 1 teaspoon (adjust to taste)
instructions: In a bowl, mix ginger-garlic paste, turmeric powder, red chili powder, garam masala, coriander powder, lemon juice, and salt.
Add the chicken pieces and coat them well with the spice mixture.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes (or longer for better flavor).
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
Once the oil is hot, add the marinated chicken pieces.
Fry the chicken for about 10-15 minutes, turning occasionally, until it's golden brown and cooked through.
Once done, remove the chicken and drain excess oil on paper towels.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with lemon wedges or any dip.

recipes.name: Pappu (Dal)
instructions: Wash toor dal thoroughly.
In a pressure cooker, add the washed dal, turmeric powder, green chilies, tomatoes, and 2-3 cups of water.
Pressure cook for 3-4 whistles or until the dal is soft and mushy.
Once the pressure releases, mash the dal slightly and set aside.
Heat oil or ghee in a small pan.
Add mustard seeds and let them splutter.
Add cumin seeds, dry red chilies, curry leaves, garlic, and a pinch of asafoetida.
Sauté until the garlic turns golden and aromatic.

recipes.name: Gongura Pachadi
ingredients: Gongura leaves (Sorrel leaves) - 2 cups (washed and chopped)
Dry red chilies - 6-8 (adjust to spice level)
Tamarind pulp - small piece (optional, if you need extra tang)
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a pan.
Add the chopped Gongura leaves and sauté on medium heat until they wilt and soften (about 5-7 minutes). Set aside to cool.
In the same pan, add a little oil and roast dry red chilies, garlic cloves, mustard seeds, and fenugreek seeds until the garlic turns golden and the spices are aromatic.
Remove from heat and let it cool.
In a blender, grind the roasted chilies, garlic, mustard seeds, and fenugreek seeds to a coarse paste.
Add the sautéed Gongura leaves, salt, and a pinch of hing. Grind everything together until it forms a coarse chutney.
Serve this simple Gongura Pachadi with hot rice, a drizzle of ghee, or as a side dish with dosa or idli.

recipes.name: Fish Curry
ingredients: Fish fillets - 500 grams (any white fish like tilapia or basa)
Red chili powder - 1 teaspoon (adjust to taste)
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
In a bowl, whisk together the eggs, pecorino, and parmesan cheese.
Cook the pancetta in a large pan until crispy.
Drain the spaghetti and reserve some pasta water.
Toss the spaghetti with the pancetta, then remove from heat and mix in the egg mixture.
Add reserved pasta water to adjust the sauce consistency.
Season with black pepper and serve immediately.

recipes.name: Tamarind Rice
instructions: Clean and wash the fish fillets. Sprinkle a little salt and turmeric powder on the fish and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until soft and golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute until the raw smell goes away.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they soften and turn mushy.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and coriander powder. Stir well.
Add water (and coconut milk if using) and bring to a boil.
Gently add the fish fillets to the curry. Let it simmer on low heat for 8-10 minutes, or until the fish is fully cooked.
Avoid stirring too much to keep the fish intact.
Once the fish is cooked, check the seasoning and add more salt if needed.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve with rice or roti.

recipes.name: Prawn Curry
ingredients: Red chili powder - 1 teaspoon (adjust to taste)
instructions: Clean and devein the prawns. Rinse them well.
Sprinkle a little salt and turmeric powder on the prawns and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan.
Add the chopped onions and sauté until they turn soft and golden.
Add ginger-garlic paste and sauté for a minute until the raw smell disappears.
Add the chopped tomatoes and cook until they become mushy.
Add turmeric powder, red chili powder, and coriander powder. Mix well.
Add water (and coconut milk if using) and bring the curry to a gentle boil.
Add the prawns to the curry. Simmer for about 5-7 minutes, or until the prawns are fully cooked. Be careful not to overcook them as prawns cook quickly.
Taste the curry and adjust salt if needed.
Garnish with fresh coriander leaves and serve hot with steamed rice or roti

recipes.name: Pootharekulu
ingredients: Rice paper wrappers (available at most stores) - 10 sheets
instructions: BIf using dry rice paper wrappers, lightly dampen them with a wet cloth to make them flexible and easy to work with.
Take one rice paper wrapper and place it on a flat surface.
Gently brush a thin layer of melted ghee over the entire sheet.
Sprinkle powdered sugar evenly on top of the ghee.
If desired, sprinkle some chopped nuts for added flavor and texture.
Fold the rice paper in thirds or roll it into a tight rectangle or burrito shape, making sure the layers are even.
Repeat the process for all the remaining rice paper wrappers.

recipes.name: Mango Pickle
ingredients: Raw mangoes - 2 medium (cut into small cubes)
instructions: Wash and dry the raw mangoes. Ensure there is no moisture.
Cut the mangoes into small cubes and set aside.
In a pan, dry roast mustard seeds and fenugreek seeds until they turn aromatic.
Once roasted, coarsely grind them into a powder and set aside.
In a mixing bowl, add the mango cubes.
Add red chili powder, turmeric powder, the ground mustard-fenugreek powder, and salt. Mix well.
Heat the oil in a small pan until it is smoking hot.
Turn off the heat and add a pinch of asafoetida (hing) to the oil.
Let the oil cool for a few minutes, then pour it over the mango-spice mixture. Mix everything thoroughly.
Let the pickle sit for 1-2 hours so the flavors blend.
Store the mango pickle in a clean, dry, airtight jar. You can start enjoying it right away, but it tastes even better after a couple of days as the flavors deepen.

recipes.name: Rotis
ingredients: Oil or ghee - 1 teaspoon (optional, for softer rotis)
instructions: Mix dough: In a bowl, combine 2 cups wheat flour with a little water and knead until soft.
Rest dough: Let the dough rest for 15 minutes.
Divide and roll: Make small dough balls, flatten them, and roll into thin circles.
Cook roti: Heat a pan, cook each roti on both sides until it puffs up and gets light brown spots.
Serve: Serve hot with ghee or butter.

recipes.name: Sandwitch
instructions: Spread butter/mayo: Take 4 slices of bread and spread butter or mayonnaise evenly on one side of each slice.
Add vegetables: On two slices, place tomato slices, cucumber slices, and lettuce.
Season: Sprinkle a pinch of salt and pepper over the veggies.
Add cheese (optional): Place a slice of cheese on top of the vegetables.
Close the sandwich: Cover the veggies with the remaining two slices of bread, buttered/mayo side down.
Toast or serve: You can toast the sandwich in a pan until golden brown on both sides or serve it as is.

recipes.name: Veg Fingers
instructions: In a bowl, mix mashed potatoes, grated carrots, and mashed peas.
Add green chilies, ginger-garlic paste, red chili powder, garam masala, coriander leaves, and salt.
Add cornflour to bind the mixture and mix everything well.
Take small portions of the mixture and shape them into long, finger-like sticks.
Roll each veg finger in breadcrumbs to coat them evenly.
Heat oil in a pan for deep frying.
Once the oil is hot, fry the veg fingers on medium heat until they are golden brown and crispy.
Remove the fried veg fingers and drain them on paper towels.
Serve hot with ketchup or chutney.
